+def dependency_solver(data, preference, name_order):
+    packages = data["packages"]
+    features = set(data.get("features", []))
+    blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+    pins = data.get("pins", {})
+    constraints = {name: [tuple(bounds)] for name, bounds in data["roots"].items()}
+    solutions = []
+
+    def visit(chosen, constraints, edges):
+        pending = [n for n in constraints if n not in chosen]
+        if not pending:
+            state = {}
+            def acyclic(n):
+                if state.get(n) == 1:
+                    return False
+                if state.get(n) == 2:
+                    return True
+                state[n] = 1
+                if any(not acyclic(v) for v in edges.get(n, ())):
+                    return False
+                state[n] = 2
+                return True
+            if all(acyclic(n) for n in chosen):
+                solutions.append(chosen.copy())
+            return
+        name = pending[0]
+        lows = [b[0] for b in constraints[name]]
+        highs = [b[1] for b in constraints[name]]
+        rows = [r for r in packages[name]
+                if max(lows) <= r["version"] <= min(highs)
+                and r["version"] not in blocked.get(name, [])
+                and (name not in pins or r["version"] == pins[name])]
+        rows.sort(key=lambda r: r["version"], reverse=(preference == "maximum"))
+        for row in rows:
+            version = row["version"]
+            ch = chosen.copy()
+            ch[name] = version
+            cs = {n: list(bs) for n, bs in constraints.items()}
+            ed = {n: list(vs) for n, vs in edges.items()}
+            ed.setdefault(name, [])
+            valid = True
+            for dep in row.get("deps", []):
+                feat = dep.get("feature", "")
+                if feat and feat not in features:
+                    continue
+                other = dep["name"]
+                ed[name].append(other)
+                cs.setdefault(other, []).append((dep["min"], dep["max"]))
+                if other in ch and not (dep["min"] <= ch[other] <= dep["max"]):
+                    valid = False
+                    break
+            if valid:
+                visit(ch, cs, ed)
+
+    visit({}, constraints, {})
+    if not solutions:
+        return {"error": "unsatisfiable"}
+    names = sorted(packages, reverse=(name_order == "descending"))
+    def vector(sol):
+        return tuple(sol.get(n, -1) for n in names)
+    best = (max if preference == "maximum" else min)(solutions, key=vector)
+    return {"versions": best}
